description: This Java class implements a manager for storing and retrieving product image files using Infinispan cache, supporting operations like add, get, and remove images, specifically for product images in an e-commerce context.

classes.name: CmsImageFileManagerInfinispanImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a product image manager using Infinispan cache, supporting CRUD operations for product images, with methods for adding, retrieving, and removing images, and managing cache nodes.

methods.name: addProductImage
methods.description: Adds a product image to the cache for a specific product, storing image data as byte array.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a specific product image from cache based on product details.

methods.name: getImages
methods.description: Retrieves all images associated with a product or merchant store.

methods.name: removeImages
methods.description: Removes all images for a given merchant store from cache.

methods.name: removeProductImage
methods.description: Removes a specific product image from cache.

methods.name: removeProductImages
methods.description: Removes all images for a specific product from cache.

methods.name: getProductImage
methods.description: Retrieves a product image with specified size and name.

methods.name: getNode
methods.description: Fetches or creates a cache node for a given path in the Infinispan cache.
